dependencies.name: video-clipper (engine package)
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary via go.mod, not copied — provides URL fetch/clip/audio-extract. This app is a real composition of two other Securexe applets' public engines, not a standalone reimplementation. Version is the go.mod pseudo-version — bump it deliberately (go get -u), don't let it drift silently.

dependencies.name: gif-maker (engine package)
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary via go.mod, not copied — provides the ffmpeg | gifski GIF conversion used once video-clipper's engine has fetched the source. Version is the go.mod pseudo-version — bump it deliberately (go get -u), don't let it drift silently.

dependencies.name: yt-dlp
dependencies.note: Not bundled, expected on PATH — resolved via video-clipper's engine, same version this app was last tested against.

dependencies.name: FFmpeg
dependencies.note: Not bundled, expected on PATH — resolved via video-clipper's and gif-maker's engines, same version this app was last tested against.

dependencies.name: gifski
dependencies.note: Not bundled, expected on PATH — resolved via gif-maker's engine, same version this app was last tested against.

requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as video-clipper, instaframe, pdf-toolkit, and gif-maker.
